requirements.source_anchor: G4 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (G4 Lineage)
requirements.requirement: Store and initialize local G4 generation as the authoritative local lineage invalidation mechanism; remoteVersion is not a substitute (INV-05, INV-11).

requirements.source_anchor: G4 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Same-Transaction Validation)
requirements.requirement: Perform generation check and remote business-data apply atomically inside the exact same Room write transaction.

requirements.source_anchor: G4 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Full Dataset Invalidation)
requirements.requirement: Increment local generation upon Restore Replace, full dataset wipe, or sign-out with data clear, immediately invalidating any in-flight remote operations.

requirements.source_anchor: G4 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 3 (Same-Lineage Mutations)
requirements.requirement: Normal local financial mutations execute as same-lineage without incrementing generation unless concurrency evidence requires invalidating in-flight state.

requirements.source_anchor: G4 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Maintenance Exclusion & Lock Order)
requirements.requirement: Enforce clean lock hierarchy and prohibit network I/O or unbounded delays while holding local business or maintenance exclusion locks.
